strategy_roster.name: Firebird MA Envelope Exhaustion
strategy_roster.notes: Documented MaLength 10 and Percent 0.3 are used on candle opens, which matches the UseHighLow false default, and the long entry is a close piercing the lower envelope with the mirrored upper-envelope close as exit. Averaging-in beyond PipStep 30, the blocking flag and the shared 30/200-pip stop and target are grid-style and not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Rijfie Pyramid
strategy_roster.notes: The stochastic is approximated by RSI(14) crossing above the low level, with 30 a fallback because the documented StochasticLowLevel has no value. Pyramiding each fixed-percent price drop, the EMA filter period, the minimum and maximum price guards and the close-time timer are dropped or left as fallbacks.

strategy_roster.name: Auto Trading Publish
strategy_roster.notes: The utility only flips an AutoTradingActive flag when the StartHour or StopHour is reached and deliberately submits no market orders. A clock-driven gate with no price-derived signal cannot be translated.

strategy_roster.name: MACD Volume BBO Reversal
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(macd(close,11,21),0) and ema(volume,6) > ema(volume,12) and macd(close,11,21) > macd_signal(close,11,21,10)
strategy_roster.notes: All documented defaults are used verbatim: VolumeShortLength 6 against VolumeLongLength 12 for the positive volume oscillator and MACD 11/21/10. The recent-low stop and the RiskReward 1.5 target are absolute price distances in the DSL sense, not percentages.

strategy_roster.name: ZigAndZag Trader
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > sma(close,20) and (5 * close + 2 * open + high + low) / 9 > donchian_low_prev(low, 20) * 1.01
strategy_roster.notes: The documented weighted price is kept exactly, while the stateful ZigZag pivots and trend buffer are replaced by 20-bar Donchian swing levels and a 20-period trend average; the documented 1 pip break is scaled to 1 percent. TrendDepth 3, ExitDepth 3, the pip stop/target and the MaxOrders cap are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Vortex MTF
strategy_roster.notes: Vortex is not in the DSL, so the plus and minus directional movements are rebuilt from the one-bar high and low changes, where 2 times SMA(2) minus the current value recovers the previous bar, and smoothed over 14 bars. True-range normalisation and the configurable higher timeframe are dropped.

strategy_roster.name: Grim Slash
strategy_roster.notes: The previous close and previous high are recovered exactly as 2 times SMA(2) minus the current value, so the documented touch of the previous close enters and the touch of the previous high exits. The documented TakeProfitPercent 15 and StopLossPercent 5 are used as-is.

strategy_roster.name: Adaptive Oscillator Threshold
strategy_roster.notes: The documented fixed BuyLevel 14 with RsiLength 2 is used for the entry, and the ExitBars 28 fixed-bar exit is expressed as bars elapsed since the last trigger. The Bufs adaptive threshold branch, AdaptiveLength 8, AdaptiveCoefficient 6 and the DollarStopLoss of 1600 are not expressible in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Gauge
strategy_roster.notes: The documented 75 percent and 25 percent thresholds are kept, but the user-supplied Min 0 and Max 100 price bounds are replaced by a 20-bar Donchian range so the gauge is meaningful on any instrument; 20 is a fallback as no period is documented. The zero-range guard is explicit and the docs state there are no stops.

strategy_roster.name: Order Block Finder
strategy_roster.notes: A bullish order block becomes a close reclaiming the short average after a run of down candles, with the confirming impulse scaled by 1 percent; Relevant Periods, Min Percent Move and Use Whole Range carry no values, so 3 bars and 1 percent are fallbacks. Open-based block boundaries and higher-timeframe confirmation are not represented.
